verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents automatic user provisioning to third-party apps (Office 365 is the documented example): changes to Workspace user accounts sync automatically to the downstream app. That covers the core 'accounts create themselves' need. The evidence never names SCIM, and it does not show groups or entitlements being pushed or provisioning triggered at the moment access is assigned. Missing for 10: explicit SCIM protocol support, group and entitlement provisioning, coverage beyond the Office 365 example, independent or hands-on corroboration.
